extraction.notes: Read in full (14 pages): the table of steps and payment conditions by policy area. Extracted the whole of policy area 2.2 Digitalisation (pages 4-5: all 15 steps with baseline and payment, and the totals) and in-scope steps elsewhere: e-market and auctions (page 2), Internet access in primary schools (page 8), the digital public register of charges (page 9), NCTS, AES, the Import Control System, eFTI and eCMR (pages 11-12). Table cells are cut short in the source, so some quotes end mid-sentence, and the converted text puts cells of one row in a fixed order; quotes follow that order. Column dates come from the table header (By Dec 2024 to By Dec 2027). Page 1 is a summary table and only restates the digitalisation total. Left out: all other policy areas; ITS road and rail framework steps and the ITS implementation step (page 11), as sector transport systems; the excel-based transitory IT solution for public investment (page 2) and the ICT Council report line (page 13), as back-office tools; teacher training in digital skills and revised curricula under reform 3.1.4 (page 8), as digital skills not directly linked to an in-scope recommendation. The source of verification and responsible entity columns are not itemised; the Ministry of Digital Transformation is the named entity for all policy area 2.2 steps. There is no Chapter 2 content. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2).
